source_refs.locator: Sections 1.1 and 1.2, climate security and migration framing

affected_groups: people relocating because of climate impacts
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020-04-15 reports: The Strategy frames climate change as a Croatian security threat and says climate-related relocation may indirectly destabilize society, while noting migration is multi-causal.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020-04-15 reports: RCP4.5 projects 5–10% summer/autumn precipitation reductions in southern Lika and southern Dalmatia for 2011–2040, with more drought periods.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020-04-15 reports: The Strategy reports earlier, shorter growing seasons and lower yields in Slavonia and Dalmatia; Dalmatian fruit, olive and grape growers face heat and drought stress.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2020-04-15 reports: Summer drought was the largest single cause of agricultural climate-variability damage in 1980–2014; reported 2013–2016 loss totaled HRK 3 billion.
